svg.title: Circular braiding machine and convergence zone (side view)
svg.desc: Computed side view of the reference case (16 carriers, r = 40 mm, R_g = 150 mm, α = 45°): carriers on the track plate, the guide ring seen edge-on, the straight free yarns converging from the ring to the fell line, and the braid on the mandrel (back half faint).
